ingredients: ½ cup almond butter or peanut butter
¼ cup honey or maple syrup
½ cup chopped nuts or seeds (optional)
instructions: Mix oats, protein powder, cinnamon, salt, and nuts/seeds in a large bowl.
Warm almond/peanut butter and honey in a small saucepan until smooth; stir in vanilla.
Pour wet mixture over dry ingredients and mix until coated.
Spread evenly on a lined baking sheet and press down gently.
Bake 12–15 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden and crisp.
Let cool completely, then break into clusters; add chocolate chips if desired.
storage: Serve with milk or plant-based alternative.
Sprinkle over yogurt or smoothie bowls for extra crunch.
serving_suggestions: Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.
Refrigerate for up to 1 month for longer freshness.
Freeze in a sealed container for up to 3 months; thaw at room temperature before serving.
